name: floci
description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
one_liner: A free program that pretends to be Amazon's cloud services on your own laptop, so developers can test cloud code without paying Amazon or needing an account.
buyer: A platform engineering lead at a company with a large AWS bill from developers testing against real cloud services in CI.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consultancy offers a 'cut your AWS dev/test bill' audit that replaces real-cloud testing with this tool in client CI pipelines.
A CI/CD platform vendor bundles it as a one-click 'local AWS testing' add-on to differentiate their pipeline product.
A training company builds a paid 'test your AWS app without an AWS account' workshop for bootcamp grads who can't afford cloud bills yet.

money_ideas.idea: Fixed-fee consulting engagement to migrate a company's test suite off real AWS onto this emulator.
Hosted, managed version of the emulator with team dashboards sold to companies that don't want to self-host.

steal_this: It's a free, well-built dev tool; the real weekend project is a short paid consulting audit showing one client exactly how many AWS dollars they'd save in CI by switching to it.
